name: Outpost Barracks
defaultDescriptions: You are inside the Outpost Barracks. Sturdy stone walls are decorated with company banners and polished shields. Guards move in disciplined formation through the halls.
A smell of weapon oil and woodsmoke fills the air. Bunk racks line the rear wall while a broad strategy table occupies the center of the command chamber.

3,4: You stand near the heavy iron-reinforced doors of the barracks, looking out into the square.
The entrance threshold is guarded by polished brass braziers casting warm light over the flagstones.
3,2: You stand before the commander's heavy oak desk, covered in regional parchment maps, casualty reports, and dispatch seals.
Commander Robert presides here over military administration, reviewing scout logs with a focused, battle-hardened gaze.

weapon_rack: Sturdy iron racks holding sharpened spears, standard-issue swords, and polished kite shields ready for immediate deployment.
war_map: A massive canvas map pinned to the timber partition, marking known bandit movements, safe roads, and expanding dark anomaly zones.
command_desk: The polished desk where official patrol assignments and bounty claims are reviewed and authorized.

triggers.label: Speak with Commander Robert
triggers.tooltip: Report to the commander regarding outpost duties and commissions.
triggers.description: Commander Robert looks up from his ledgers, evaluating you with a measured and disciplined nod.
